# Resolve species names

Resolve species in all datasets to GBIF accepted names using the package taxize:

## Species in sensitivity data

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(slopes_all_species$Species) # 187
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
spp1 <- slopes_all_species$Species[1:50]
spp2 <- slopes_all_species$Species[51:100]
spp3 <- slopes_all_species$Species[101:150]
spp4 <- slopes_all_species$Species[151:187]

# Getting current canonical names
resolved_1 <- gna_verifier(spp1, data_sources = 11) # 11 = GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
resolved_2 <- gna_verifier(spp2, data_sources = 11)
resolved_3 <- gna_verifier(spp3, data_sources = 11)
resolved_4 <- gna_verifier(spp4, data_sources = 11)

# Combining all of the names
all_resolved <- rbind(resolved_1, resolved_2, resolved_3, resolved_4)

# Add to sp_list
slopes_all_species_resolved <- slopes_all_species %>%
  cbind(., all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull) %>%
  rename(name_res = `all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull`)
slopes_all_resolved <- slopes_all %>%
  left_join(slopes_all_species_resolved)
```

## Species in  Red List data

Resolve species (`sPlot concept unified`) to GBIF accepted names:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(unique(redlist$`sPlot concept unified`)) # 21096
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
# Chunk the names into groups of <= 50
chunk_size <- 50
chunks <- split(unique(redlist$`sPlot concept unified`), 
                ceiling(seq_along(unique(redlist$`sPlot concept unified`)) / 
                          chunk_size))

# Helper to resolve one chunk using GBIF Backbone (data_sources = 11)
resolve_chunk_tbl <- function(x) {
  gna_verifier(
    names = x,
    data_sources = 11,       # GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
    all_matches = FALSE,     # best match only
    output_type = "table"
  )
}

# Try table output first
resolved_tbl <- tryCatch(
  {
    map(chunks, resolve_chunk_tbl) %>% bind_rows()
  },
  error = function(e) NULL
)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
resolved_tbl2 <- resolved_tbl %>%
  rename(
    rl_name_clean = submittedName,           
    name_res = currentCanonicalFull
  ) %>%
  # If duplicates exist in resolved_tbl (same submitted name multiple times),
  # keep the first/best one:
  distinct(rl_name_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

redlist_with_clean <- redlist %>%
  mutate(
    rl_name_raw   = `sPlot concept unified`,
    rl_name_clean = str_squish(rl_name_raw)
  )

# Left-join: keep ALL rows from redlist
redlist_resolved <- redlist_with_clean %>%
  left_join(resolved_tbl2 %>%
              select(rl_name_clean, name_res), 
            by = "rl_name_clean")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
resolved_tbl_list <- vector("list", length(chunks))
for (i in seq_along(chunks)) {

      " (n =", length(chunks[[i]]), ")\n")
  res <- try(resolve_chunk_tbl(chunks[[i]]), silent = TRUE)
```

# Create occurrence matrix

Occurrence matrices are created using the package rgbif. 

## Get countries form RL

We want to get an occurrence matrix for all countries in Europe that are included in our Red List data.

```{r}
# Inspect all countries present in Red List sample
redlist %>% distinct(Country) %>% arrange(Country) %>% print(n = 50)
```

Get vector of countries (remove NA).

```{r}
countries_raw <- redlist %>%
  distinct(Country) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Country)) %>%
  pull(Country)
```

Convert country names to ISO2 country codes (used by rgbif).

```{r}
# Custom mapping for tricky names
# - GBIF wants 'GB' for United Kingdom / Great Britain
# - 'Czech Republic' -> 'CZ'
# - 'Bosnia and Herzegovina' -> 'BA'
# - 'Russia' -> 'RU'
# - 'Kosovo' -> 'XK' (unofficial but accepted by GBIF)
custom_match <- c(
  "United Kingdom"        = "GB",
  "Great Britain"         = "GB",
  "Czech Republic"        = "CZ",
  "Bosnia and Herzegovina"= "BA",
  "Russia"                = "RU",
  "Kosovo"                = "XK"
)

# Convert to ISO-2 (countrycode handles the rest)
countries_iso <- tibble(
  country_name = countries_raw,
  iso2 = countrycode(countries_raw,
                     origin = "country.name",
                     destination = "iso2c",
                     custom_match = custom_match)
) %>%
  arrange(country_name)
countries_iso
# Final clean vector for rgbif
gbif_iso2 <- countries_iso %>%
  filter(!is.na(iso2)) %>%
  distinct(iso2) %>%
  pull(iso2)

gbif_iso2
```

## Build occurrence matrix

Build the species × country occurrence matrix with rgbif.

Get species and countries vectors.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sp_vec <- unique(slopes_all_species_resolved$name_res)
cty_vec <- unique(gbif_iso2)
```

Use parallel GBIF querying.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
options(timeout = 180)                      # allow slower responses
options(future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore")     # silence RNG warning when seed is set
```


```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# Retry wrapper: tries 'expr_fun()' up to 'tries' times with exponential backoff
retry <- function(expr_fun, tries = 3L, base_wait = 0.7) {
  for (i in seq_len(tries)) {
    ok <- try(expr_fun(), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(ok, "try-error")) return(ok)
    Sys.sleep(base_wait * (2^(i - 1)))  # 0.7s, 1.4s, 2.8s ...
  }
  ok
}

# Robust count helper using occ_count() with retries
get_species_country_count <- function(sp, iso2) {
  # Load packages inside each worker
  require(rgbif, quietly = TRUE, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
  require(tibble, quietly = TRUE, warn.conflicts = FALSE)

  out <- retry(function() rgbif::occ_count(scientificName = sp, country = iso2))

  # If still failed, coerce to 0
  if (inherits(out, "try-error") || is.null(out)) {
    return(tibble(species = sp, iso2 = iso2, count = 0L, status = "error"))
  }

  tibble(species = sp, iso2 = iso2, count = as.integer(out %||% 0L), status = "ok")
}
```

Build species × country combinations.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
pairs_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  species = sp_vec,
  iso2    = gbif_iso2
)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
workers <- 4
future::plan(multisession, workers = workers)

batch_size <- 100L
borders <- seq(1L, nrow(pairs_df), by = batch_size)
batch_ids <- cut(seq_len(nrow(pairs_df)), 
                 breaks = c(borders, nrow(pairs_df) + 1L), 
                 include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)

batches <- split(pairs_df, batch_ids)

# Progress bar across batches (not inside workers)
pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "GBIF batches [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta: :eta",
  total = length(batches),
  clear = FALSE
)

all_results <- vector("list", length(batches))
error_log  <- list()

for (b in seq_along(batches)) {
  chunk <- batches[[b]]

  # Parallel over the rows of this chunk
  chunk_res <- try(
    {
      future_pmap(
        .l = chunk,  # pass the whole data frame (= list of cols)
        .f = function(species, iso2) {
          get_species_country_count(species, iso2)
        },
        .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE, scheduling = 1) # scheduling=1 = predictable
      )
    },
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(chunk_res, "try-error")) {
    # Record batch-level failure
    error_log[[length(error_log) + 1]] <- list(batch = b, error = as.character(chunk_res))
    # Fallback: try sequentially for this batch to salvage results
    chunk_res <- purrr::pmap(chunk, function(species, iso2) get_species_country_count(species, iso2))
  }

  # Bind rows from this batch
  all_results[[b]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(chunk_res)
  pb$tick()
}

results <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_results)

# Inspect failures, if any
fail_count <- sum(results$status != "ok")
if (fail_count > 0) {
  message("Requests with errors after retries: ", fail_count,
          ". They were set to count = 0. See 'error_log' for batch-level issues.")
}

plan(sequential)
```

Checks.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results %>% count(status)
fail_count
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
failed <- results %>%
  dplyr::filter(status == "error") %>% 
  dplyr::select(species, iso2)
failed
```

```{r}
retry2 <- function(expr_fun, tries = 6L, base_wait = 1.0) {
  for (i in seq_len(tries)) {
    ok <- try(expr_fun(), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(ok, "try-error") && !is.null(ok)) return(ok)
    Sys.sleep(base_wait * (2^(i - 1)))  # 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 seconds
  }
  ok
}
```

```{r}
get_species_country_count2 <- function(sp, iso2) {
  require(rgbif, quietly = TRUE)
  require(tibble, quietly = TRUE)

  out <- retry2(function() rgbif::occ_count(scientificName = sp,
                                            country = iso2))

  if (inherits(out, "try-error") || is.null(out)) {
    return(tibble(species = sp, iso2 = iso2,
                  count = NA_integer_, status = "still_error"))
  }

  tibble(species = sp, iso2 = iso2,
         count = as.integer(out), status = "ok2")
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
fix_results <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  failed,
  function(species, iso2) get_species_country_count2(species, iso2)
)
fix_results
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results_fixed <- results %>%
  dplyr::rows_update(
    fix_results,
    by = c("species", "iso2")
  )
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results_fixed %>%
  filter(status != "ok" & status != "ok2")
```

Build the presence/absence matrix.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

  mutate(presence = as.integer(count > 0)) %>%
  select(species, iso2, presence) %>%

    values_from = presence,
    values_fill = 0
```

Try to match the full PhenObs spp list with the RL to see how many species are there in each category for each country.

## Add ISO2 country codes to RL

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

  left_join(countries_iso %>% rename(Country = country_name))
```

## Join RL and spp list in sensitivity data from PhenObs

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs <- tibble(slopes_all_species_resolved) %>%
  left_join(redlist_resolved) %>%
  # Keep columns that I think I will use
  select(name_res, Redlist_cat, Threat, Country, Publ_year, redlist_source, 
         Continent, iso2)
redlist_phenobs
```

## Data prep RL

Cases where there is info for more than one year for a species and country:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_dupl_diff <- redlist_phenobs %>%
  group_by(name_res, iso2) %>%
  filter(n() > 1, n_distinct(Threat) > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
redlist_phenobs_dupl_diff
```

Keep threat info for the latest publication year. In Russia, there is no info about publication year.

Keep Russia separated:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_Russia <- redlist_phenobs %>%
  filter(iso2 == "RU")
```

Remove Russia:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_noRussia <- redlist_phenobs %>%
  filter(iso2 != "RU")
```

For other countries apart from Russia: If there are several rows for same publication year, pick the most severe red list category.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
severity_order <- c("CR", "EN", "VU", "NT", "LC")

redlist_phenobs_noRussia_latest <- redlist_phenobs_noRussia %>%
  group_by(name_res, iso2) %>%
  filter(if (all(is.na(Publ_year))) TRUE else 
    Publ_year == max(Publ_year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(which.min(match(Redlist_cat, severity_order))) %>%
  ungroup()

redlist_phenobs_noRussia_latest
```

Check that there is only one entry for each species and country:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_noRussia_latest %>% 
  group_by(name_res, iso2) %>%
  count() %>% filter(n > 1)
```

For Russia:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
severity_threatened <- c("CR", "EN", "VU")
severity_not_threatened <- c("NT", "LC")

redlist_phenobs_Russia <- redlist_phenobs_Russia %>%
  group_by(name_res) %>%
  # Apply custom logic to pick ONE row but keep all columns
  slice({
    threatened_count <- sum(Threat == "threatened")
    not_threatened_count <- sum(Threat == "not_threatened")
    
    # If there are more threatened rows than not threatened
    if (threatened_count > not_threatened_count) {
      # pick the first threatened row
      which.max(Threat == "threatened") 
      # Else if there are more not threatened rows
    } else if (not_threatened_count > threatened_count) {
      # pick the first not threatened row
      which.max(Threat == "not_threatened")
    } else {
      # If there is a tie between threatened and not threatened rows,
      # break by severity groups.
      # Count severity categories
      threatened_severity_count <- sum(Redlist_cat %in% severity_threatened)
      not_threatened_severity_count <- sum(Redlist_cat %in% severity_not_threatened)
      # If threatened severity count ≥ not threatened severity count
      if (threatened_severity_count >= not_threatened_severity_count) {
        # Picks the first row with CR/EN/VU
        which.max(Redlist_cat %in% severity_threatened)
        # Else
      } else {
        # Picks the first row with NT/LC
        which.max(Redlist_cat %in% severity_not_threatened)
      }
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

For Russia, check that there is only one entry for each species:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_Russia %>% group_by(name_res) %>%
  count() %>% filter(n > 1)
```

Join noRussia and Russia to get final RL for PhenObs:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_final <- bind_rows(redlist_phenobs_noRussia_latest,
                                   redlist_phenobs_Russia)
# Note that species that are not threatened in any country 
# are absent from redlist_phenobs_final
```


# Join occurrence data and Red List data 

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_final_occ <- 
  # Here, all 187 species are included
  occ_matrix_pa %>% 
  select(-n_countries) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:43), names_to = "iso2", values_to = "occurrence") %>%
  # Here, only the species included in red lists in ANY country (i.e. 162 spp)
  # are included
  left_join(redlist_phenobs_final, by = c("species" = "name_res",
                                        "iso2" = "iso2")) %>%
  # Remove unneded columns
  select(-Redlist_cat, -Country, -Publ_year, -redlist_source, -Continent) %>%
  # Rename
  rename(country = iso2, threat = Threat) %>%
  # Order columns
  select(species, country, occurrence, threat) %>%
  # Set those where threat is NA or not_evaluated_dd (only 2 spp in Russia)
  # as not_threatened
  mutate(threat = case_when(
    threat == "not_evaluated_dd" ~ "not_threatened",
    is.na(threat) ~ "not_threatened",
    TRUE ~ threat
  ))
```

# Calculate % endangerment

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
perc_endangerment <- redlist_phenobs_final_occ %>%
  filter(occurrence > 0) %>%  # only countries where species is present
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_countries = n_distinct(country),
    threatened_countries = sum(threat == "threatened"),
    perc_endangerment = (threatened_countries / total_countries) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(species) %>%
  # Have it also as a proportion
  mutate(prop_endangerment = perc_endangerment / 100)
perc_endangerment
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hist(perc_endangerment$prop_endangerment)
```

# Prepare datasets for models

## Sensitivity + % endangerment

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
  left_join(
    slopes_all_resolved %>% 
      select(name_res, starts_with("mean_"), starts_with("slope_var"),
             starts_with("sens_01_")),
    by = c("species" = "name_res"),
    )
sens_per_endanger %>% filter(is.na(perc_endangerment)) %>% nrow()
sens_per_endanger %>% filter(is.na(mean_slope_FlOn)) %>% nrow() # 16 spp
sens_per_endanger %>% filter(is.na(mean_slope_GSL)) %>% nrow() # 33 spp
```

## Sensitivity + % endangerment + stress

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

  left_join(stress_resolved, by = c("species" = "name_res")) %>%
  select(-Species)
```

## Sensitivity + % endangerment + Ellenberg tendency of change

Deal with non-numeric values in indicator values

Columns OEK_L - OEK_S and HAEUF_AE_change

```{r}
ellenberg <- ellenberg %>%
  mutate(across(OEK_L:OEK_S, ~ parse_number(.)))
```

Join with sens_per_endanger:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sens_per_endanger_stress_ell <- sens_per_endanger_stress %>%
  left_join(ellenberg_resolved %>%
              select(name_res, HAEUF_AE_change) %>%
              rename(change = HAEUF_AE_change) %>%
              group_by(name_res) %>%
              # For duplicates, get the mean
              summarise(change = as.integer(mean(change, na.rm = TRUE)),
                        .groups = "drop"), 
            by = c("species" = "name_res"))
```

# Models endangerment ~ sensitivity 

Filtering slope_var < 50 - clearer patterns.

Binomial models with cbind(threatened_countries, total_countries - threatened_countries).

Added prediction plots only for models with any significant effects.

## Sensitive or not

```{r}
stage_names <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  distinct(stage) %>%
  pull(stage)

mod_sens_01 <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glmmTMB(cbind(threatened_countries, 
                        total_countries - threatened_countries) ~ sens_01, 
                   data = .x, 
                  # Use betabinomial because of overdispersion with binomial
                  family = betabinomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

map_df(mod_sens_01, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_01$FlPeak))
```

## Sensitivity sign

```{r}
sens_endanger <- sens_endanger %>%
  mutate(sens_sign = factor(case_when(
    mean_slope > 0 ~ "positive",
    mean_slope < 0 ~ "negative",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )))
```

```{r}

  group_map(~ glmmTMB(cbind(threatened_countries, 
                        total_countries - threatened_countries) ~ sens_sign, 
                      data = .x, family = betabinomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

map_df(mod_sens_sign, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%

```


# Models Ellenberg tendency of change (declining / not) ~ sensitivity

Declining species defined as those with a trend index <= 3 (as in Ozinga et al. 2009).

We create a new variable "decline", which is 1 if trend index <= 3, and 0 otherwise.

```{r}
sens_endanger_stress_ell <- sens_endanger_stress_ell %>%
  mutate(decline = ifelse(is.na(change), NA, ifelse(change <= 3, 1, 0)))
```

Filtering slope_var < 50 - clearer patterns.

```{r}
mod_sens_01_decl <- sens_endanger_stress_ell %>%

  group_map(~ glmmTMB(decline ~ sens_01, 
                   data = .x, 
                  family = binomial)) %>%
```

# PCA

```{r}
pca_phen <- prcomp(sens_per_endanger %>% 
                     select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>%
                     drop_na(), 
                   center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
```

```{r}
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_phen$x) %>%
  mutate(species = (sens_per_endanger %>%
                      select(species, starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>%
                      drop_na())$species) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(abs(PC1) > quantile(abs(PC1), 0.95) |
                          abs(PC2) > quantile(abs(PC2), 0.95),
                        species, ""))
```

```{r}
# Variable loadings for arrows
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_phen$rotation) %>%
  mutate(variable = rownames(.)) %>%
  # Remove mean_slope from variable names
  mutate(variable = gsub("mean_slope_", "", variable))

ggplot(scores %>%
         left_join(
           sens_per_endanger %>% 
             select(species, prop_endangerment)
           ), 
       aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, color = "steelblue"
             ) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1*3, yend = PC2*3),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "darkred") +
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings,
                  aes(x = PC1*3, y = PC2*3, label = variable),
                  color = "red3", size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
```

```{r}
plot(pca_phen)
```

## Clustering

```{r}
dist_pcs <- dist(scores %>%
                   select(PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4), 
                 method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_pcs, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
scores$cluster <- factor(cutree(hc, k = 3))
ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Plot with clusters

```{r}
ggplot(
  scores %>%
    left_join(
      sens_per_endanger %>% 
        select(species, prop_endangerment),
      by = "species"
    ),
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 3, yend = PC2 * 3),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = PC1 * 4, y = PC2 * 4, label = variable),
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    nudge_x = 0.1* sign(loadings$PC1),
    nudge_y = 0.1 * sign(loadings$PC2),
    box.padding = 0.2,      # distance around text box
    point.padding = 0.2,    # distance from arrows/points
    max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  #stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.8))
```

# RDA effect of endangerment

## Endangered or not

```{r}
rda_trait_endanger <- rda(
  sens_per_endanger %>% select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>% drop_na() ~ 
    (sens_per_endanger %>%
       mutate(endangerment = factor(
         ifelse(prop_endangerment == 0, 0, 1)))%>% drop_na())$endangerment,
  data = sens_per_endanger
  )
anova(rda_trait_endanger, permutations = 999)
anova(rda_trait_endanger, by = "axis", permutations = 999)
RsquareAdj(rda_trait_endanger)
```

## Proportion of endangerment

```{r}
rda_trait_endanger_prop <- rda(
  sens_per_endanger %>% select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>% drop_na() ~ 
    (sens_per_endanger%>% drop_na())$prop_endangerment,
  data = sens_per_endanger
  )
anova(rda_trait_endanger_prop, permutations = 999)
anova(rda_trait_endanger_prop, by = "axis", permutations = 999)
RsquareAdj(rda_trait_endanger_prop)
```
